current_text.html:
Only two (2) ad interim committees may be appointed or continued in any given year, unless additional ones are approved by a two-thirds (2/3) vote of the Assembly.

Funds for ad interim committees will ordinarily be administered by the Administrative Committee, with contributions to the AC being designated for a particular ad interim committee. Any motion to task the Administrative Committee with the funding of an ad interim committee through undesignated giving would require the approval of a two-thirds (2/3) vote of the Assembly as an amendment to the AC budget (per RAO 4-11).

Any overture proposing an ad interim committee should ordinarily include a plan for how sufficient, designated funds for the ad interim committee will be raised. Funding should not be the burden primarily of the members of the ad interim committee or the AC, but of those requesting the ad interim committee. Permanent Committees and Agencies of the PCA may grant monies toward the funding of an ad interim committee.

relationships.title: Study committee to review and reform judicial rules

occurrences.excerpt: CCB found this overture in conflict (with existing provisions), yet adopted 8-0-0, proposing a study committee to examine changes to PCA judicial rules under RAO 9-3.

relationships.title: Clarifying funding procedures for ad interim committees

occurrences.excerpt: An overture amending RAO 9-3 to clarify how ad interim committees are funded was found not in conflict and adopted.

relationships.title: Domestic Oppression
relationships.disposition: in conflict; Adopted by the CCB

occurrences.excerpt: An overture to form an ad interim committee addressing domestic abuse, domestic oppression, and sexual assault was found in conflict with RAO 9-3 but adopted by the CCB.
